title: Orsen and the Verdict
author: Hazel Yarrow
blurb: Elodie Ravensworth, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
